verdict.rationale: Expensify's own docs say it can create, submit, approve and reimburse expenses, and SmartScan captures receipt data. A community user also describes submitting expenses for reimbursement. The evidence never covers the payout method, the timing, or end-to-end status tracking. Missing for 10: documented direct-deposit/ACH payout, evidence of reimbursement arriving within days, status tracking from submission to payout, independent corroboration of the payout itself.

support.subject: As an employee, I can submit an out-of-pocket expense and get reimbursed by direct deposit in days, tracked from submission to payout

citations.quote: Automatically create, submit, approve, and reimburse expenses.
Open the app, tap the camera, and SmartScan reads the merchant, date, total, and currency automatically.
